title: Alden queue ranking settings ([queue.rank] in config.toml)

urgentLabel.description: a label like hotfix, urgent, critical, blocker, p0 or sev1: 6 points (0 ignores it, 1 is the default)

stacked.description: open PRs built on top of this one: 4 points (0 ignores it, 1 is the default)

sameAuthor.description: a teammate with several PRs waiting on you: 2 points (0 ignores it, 1 is the default)

ownsFiles.description: you own changed files through CODEOWNERS: 1 point (0 ignores it, 1 is the default)

waiting.description: how long you've been asked: 1.5 points after 4 hours, 3 after a day, 4.5 after three days (0 ignores it, 1 is the default)

size.description: lines to read, lockfiles aside: 1 point past the fast-track size, 2 past 250 lines, 3 past 1,000 (0 ignores it, 1 is the default)

risk.description: sensitive paths (migrations, auth, payments, infra, CI, lockfiles) and major dependency bumps: 2 each (0 ignores it, 1 is the default)

noTests.description: code changes with no test changes: 1 point (0 ignores it, 1 is the default)

learned.description: what Alden learned from the PRs you open first or mark useful: up to 3 points either way (0 ignores it, 1 is the default)

rules.description: applied after learning, which never overrides them

path.description: a changed file matches this glob, e.g. "**/payments/**"; a plain "payments/" means that folder anywhere

label.description: the PR has this label (any case)

author.description: a login ("sam", "dependabot", "copilot"), or "people", "bots" or "agents" (AI coding agents)

repo.description: owner/name, or an organisation for all of its repos

base.description: the branch it merges into, or a glob: "main", "release/*"

then.description: first: above every PR the rule doesn't match in its lane; last: below them; boost or lower: add or take away points

by.description: points for boost or lower (default 5); ignored for first and last

name.description: how the row names the rule: "payments" in "↑ your rule: payments"
